rights: All protocol artwork remains the property of its respective owner. These are original publicly served brand assets used to identify protocols in a neutral ecosystem directory; no art has been redrawn or recolored.
mappingPolicy: Artwork identifies named directory families. It does not verify ownership of every grouped deployment. Specific ambiguous hook names require contextual evidence; unknown families use a neutral dash. Uniswap Labs reference hooks require all deployments to match the official repository chain/address table. An original that is dark on transparent, or that colours itself by the visitor's colour scheme, is shown unaltered on a light plate (manifest field plate: "light" with plateReason); the plate sets the colour scheme to light and the file is never recoloured.

Official Phi documentation describes ETH wrapping 1:1 into PhiEth and fair-launch pools using Uniswap v4 hooks; it names the Publiphi workflow. Registry PhiEthHooks explicitly wraps/unwraps PhiEth and BoardHook exposes publiphi. Official documentation links to PHI-LABS-INC Github, whose own organization avatar is used here. The source domains currently return parking redirects to direct requests; identity is supported by the web-crawled official docs plus the live official Github organization, not by a parking-page favicon. No factory-level ownership verification was completed. If exact address verification is mandatory, keep these families neutral until it is obtained.
